Sergeant Zahurul Haque
2015-02-15T00:00:00+06:00 | Staff Correspondent
https://www.thedailystar.net/sergeant-zahurul-haque-64870

Today is the 46th death anniversary of Shaheed Sergeant Zahurul Haque. Zahurul, an accused of Agartala conspiracy case, was killed by Pakistan military in 1969, says a press release. Following the killing, the movement demanding unconditional release of Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman and other arrestees in the case got a momentum.
